title: Hamster ANV ruleset
description: One file per tax year (rules-<year>.json). Read by Hamster on launch and on Reload. Unknown fields or rule types are errors, so a typo never changes a result silently.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this schema. Bumped only when the format changes.

ruleset.description: Display name, e.g. "2026 v1". Bump vN whenever an open year's file changes.

basedOn.description: Ruleset this file was duplicated from, e.g. "2025 v2". Informational.

notes.description: Free text for yourself. Not shown in the app.

gwgLimit.description: Purchases up to this net-of-share cost count fully in the year paid. Above it they are depreciated.

halfYearFrom.description: MM-DD. Bought on or after this day: first and last depreciation slice count half. Usually "07-01".

werbungskostenpauschale.description: Shown as a hint when the Werbungskosten total is lower. Estimate only.

usefulLife.description: Default useful life in years per asset class. Items reference a class; a document can override it.

kilometergeld.description: Per-km rates by vehicle and date range. A trip uses the rate valid on its date. Ranges for one vehicle must not overlap.

questions.description: Yearly numbers the person answers on the tax year page. Empty means unanswered. Rules refer to them by id.

help.description: Short hint under the label, e.g. where to find the number.

unit.description: Shown next to the field, e.g. "days" or "€".

sections.description: Groups on the tax year page, in this order. A section is only shown once it has an entry.

key.description: Stable id. Never rename it once documents use it.

verified.description: false shows an "unverified" marker in Settings → Status.

kz.description: Kennzahl in the L1 form. "718/916" for fields that belong together.

kind.description: documents: invoices and receipts. trips: date, destination, km. amount: a number you type, optionally with an evidence PDF. reportedByOthers: shown for information, never copied.

visible.description: false hides the item for this year without deleting it.

evidence.description: Whether a PDF must be attached before the entry counts.

privateShare.description: Default private share in percent. Pre-fills the work share on new entries; can be changed per entry. Part of the copy value.

depreciation.description: Entries above the GWG limit are spread over the useful life. Part of the copy value.

estimate.description: What the tax office applies after you copy the value. Never changes the copy value; only adds a note.

note.description: One line shown under the Kennzahl.

carryOver.description: Whether the part above the cap counts in later years.

question.description: An amount question whose answer the tax office subtracts.
